{"id":1519990348,"question_id":3219,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1737808420,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"135 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1519990348/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Make Lexicographically Smallest Array by Swapping Elements","memory":"149.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\n    #define pii pair<int,int>\npublic:\n    vector<int> lexicographicallySmallestArray(vector<int>& nums, int limit) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<pii>copy;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            copy.push_back(make_pair(nums[i],i));\n        }\n        sort(copy.begin() , copy.end());\n\n        \n        int left =0 ,right =1;\n        while(right < n)\n        {\n            vector<int> pos = {copy[left].second};\n            \n            while(right < n && (copy[right].first - copy[right-1].first <= limit))\n            {\n                pos.push_back(copy[right].second);\n                right++;\n            }\n\n            sort(pos.begin() , pos.end());\n\n            for(int i= 0 ; i< right-left ; i++)\n            {\n            nums[pos[i]] = copy[left+i].first;\n            }\n            left = right;\n            right++;\n        }\n    return nums;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"make-lexicographically-smallest-array-by-swapping-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":247}
